summary: One record per medical history event per subject. Code terms with MedDRA like AE, and mark pre-specified conditions with MHPRESP and MHOCCUR.

MHTERM.tip: The condition as written on the CRF.

MHDECOD.tip: MedDRA preferred term, if you code medical history.

MHCAT.tip: Useful to separate e.g. "GENERAL MEDICAL HISTORY" from disease-specific history.

MHENRTPT.tip: "ONGOING" with MHENTPT (e.g. "SCREENING") for conditions still present at screening.
